newsitem.title: USA: NYC seeks underwriters' plans for new debt sales.
newsitem.headline: NYC seeks underwriters' plans for new debt sales.

text.p: New York City's new financing authority on Friday said municipal bond underwriters have until April 30 to submit their plans outlining how they would handle its bonds sales.
New York City Transitional Finance Authority said it was seeking proposals from firms that want to serve as senior or co-managing underwriter.

The new authority, which was created this year by Albany lawmakers, was designed to get around a state-imposed limit on how much general obligation debt that New York City can issue. Authority officials have said they expected it to start selling bonds as soon as late August or early September.
During the city's 1998 fiscal year, New York City was expected to sell just under $1.3 billion of bonds through the new authority and about $1.3 billion of general obligation bonds.
